request.text: The shot was working and I was dropping weight. But I felt like someone had filled my gut with concrete and forgotten about it. I'd eat a few bites at dinner and feel like I'd swallowed a brick. My jeans were getting looser but I was still leaving the dinner table early. Everyone kept telling me how great I looked, and I couldn't explain it to anyone without sounding dramatic. Because from the outside, everything was working. And I genuinely thought losing the weight would fix it. My doctor told me to add more fiber, so I started mixing fiber powder into my water every morning and eating high-fiber everything. I gave it a couple of months and if anything I felt worse, still waking up every morning with my gut full of yesterday. So I went to the pharmacy and got MiraLAX. And that felt like admitting something had genuinely gone wrong. I stood in that aisle thinking I shouldn't need this, but I was desperate enough that I didn't care. It helped a little, but the moment it wore off I was right back where I started. Something was still missing.
